decisions.reason: The electronic music box combines woodcraft with music features already offered by the firm, but its electronic component is less central to existing knowledge, so the firm can only partially assimilate and improve it.
The wooden nativity stable is very close to the firm's traditional handcrafted wooden seasonal products, giving high absorptive capacity to interpret results and refine the product.
The modern incense smoker figurine builds on core woodcraft and design knowledge while extending it with contemporary styling, so the firm can readily learn from early market response.
